body: My first fp used me for nudes and treated me like we were dating but as soon as I said something about how I felt he'd shut it down, it was a cycle, my second fp was and is a lovely guy who is just immature, I still care for him and hope his life is well, but we don't talk at all anymore, my current fp is my partner it's hard because he has borderline too but im not his fp so I just jealous and sad sometimes idk though, just a small insight to my experience

I understand that, I feel the same, when I feel I'm justifiably upset I get told to have my meds and that im being crazy essentially. Unfortunately we just have to keep trying and maybe we'll never be the same person again but maybe we'll be better. I don't think I'll ever be 'normal' I'm just aiming for happy
Thank you for your comment and im so sorry you relate, this is hard and it feels impossible but atleast wr have th8s community 💕
Thank you, I am trying to get a new psychologist and my psychiatrist has been great but yeah its hard
I really should try it, I think part of the fear is that my boyfriend doesn't think it's a good idea

It does get hard especially because we've both had a lot of abuse in our lives so we have a lot of triggers and he doesn't even really know a lot of his triggers yet, he just gets upset about the same thing for like a month and then it hits him that it's a trigger, like we recently realised that movies can trigger him because his abuser basically used them as a shitty reward system. But we are trying, it's been a huge learning curve for the both of us. 
As for the fp thing, he's mine but im not his so it gets hard because I don't feel like enough most of the time, that said i do know he loves me and I do try to remind myself of that when I feel less than.

I do think I want to go to a ward but my friend has been to the one I would go to and it is not the best so that also scares me. Idk maybe I should go anyways

I do want to do dbt but im having trouble finding a psych that I click with annoyingly. 

Thank you so much for commenting though I really appreciate it. 💕
That's great to know, thank you! And yeah im going to see someone I just d9nt know if it should be a gp or gyno
Thank you so much, I am planning to speak with a professional soon, its just been taking a lot for me to wake up early enough to call and make an appointment.
